cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(hyperos_ui_skipper)

# payload_dex.h is generated by build.ps1 right before this is invoked; it is
# not checked into git (see .gitignore).
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/payload_dex.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "payload_dex.h missing - run build.ps1 first")
endif()

add_library(hyperosuiskipper SHARED module.cpp)

target_include_directories(hyperosuiskipper PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

target_link_libraries(hyperosuiskipper log)

set_target_properties(hyperosuiskipper PROPERTIES
    CXX_STANDARD 17
    CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
)

target_compile_options(hyperosuiskipper PRIVATE -Wall -fvisibility=hidden -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
target_link_options(hyperosuiskipper PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-s)
